Keep all Redis source identity/server/DB/prefix/exclusion/TTL/capacity fields unchanged and validate the policy. Feed the same original policy into discovery and worker request construction. Default acceptance tests stay acceptance; CompleteNonDR stays full-six functional_test. Do not change the admitted task, drop a domain, or repair a sealed plan/source after capture.
primary_finding.minimum_real_installer_contract: For this ordinary deployment, the independently authorized installer must prepare Discovery.Redis.Policy.Purpose=functional_test and preserve preserve_absolute TTL before the original sourceMetadataScope/grant and pinned capture bundle are signed/frozen. If an installed original bundle says acceptance, publishing ordinary readiness from it is insufficient; reject with a specific source-purpose/materials mismatch until an authorized matching bundle is installed. The current single fixed-purpose bundle cannot be treated as an automatically dual-purpose authorization.
primary_finding.no_production_shortcut: Do not assign purpose from the task inside freezeProductionSource, weaken productionMountsFromOriginal, synthesize a new signed source grant, edit frozen metadata/source bytes, or substitute the aligned CONTENT fixture for the actual original SQL path.
primary_finding.source_scope_precision: sourceMetadataScope hashes the complete original capture materials including Discovery.Redis.Policy.Purpose. In contrast, worker.FormalSourceScopeSHA256 for shared Redis binds source identity/version/SHA, TLS mapping, Redis boundary, prefixes/exclusions and TTLPolicy, not the task Purpose. Do not falsely claim that changing only Purpose necessarily changes that worker delegation hash; the original metadata scope/signature/pin still prevents a runtime rewrite.
